QR codes you can save, and tidy link previews when you share.

## Added

- **Save the QR code as a PNG.** The share QR can be downloaded as a crisp 4×
  PNG — handy for printing or pasting into a chat. Pure client-side, no extra
  dependency or server round-trip.
- **Link previews (Open Graph / Twitter cards).** A shared link now renders a
  branded preview card with a 1200×630 image and matching title/description.
  The card is deliberately generic — a `/d/<slug>` link never leaks the file's
  name.
- **"Save QR code" is translated in all 26 languages.**
